method: Actual JavaScript gate in headless Chromium, with a 390 px mobile viewport and external requests blocked.
sample: All labeled DSS frames as supplied, plus one deterministic transform of each per distortion.

variants.original: Raw supplied photo, decoded by the browser with EXIF orientation.
variants.blur_moderate: Gaussian blur with a 3 px radius at the gate's 224 px analysis scale.
variants.blur_severe: Gaussian blur with a 14 px radius at the gate's 224 px analysis scale.
variants.clipped_severe: RGB remapped to [250, 255], clipping highlights and removing contrast.
variants.flat: Uniform fill with the mean color of the original.

limits: Corrupted cases are paired with the original frames. They are controlled diagnostic cases, not measured field rejection rates.
The gate tests readability and has no semantics or object-location signal.
